sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your offer and your kind words. We value our long cooperation with your family and your team just as much, and we take the rise in wages seriously.

We have reviewed your delivery performance in our supplier scorecard (sc:DEMO-F1@2026Q2, sc:DEMO-F1@2026Q3). We have a bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part (cost:part:PH-100).

To give both sides security, we propose three options, each with a 24-month term:

- Option A: EUR 48.67 per unit, payment 60 days net, 24 months, valid from 2027-04-01
- Option B: EUR 47.21 per unit, payment 60 days net, 24 months, valid from 2026-12-01
- Option C: EUR 48.28 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24 months, valid from 2027-04-01

Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we understand the drivers together?

We look forward to your thoughts.

Warm regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Furthermore, we checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

We value our long-standing partnership and welcome your suggestion of a 24-month contract, which provides valuable planning security for both sides. Building on your Option C, we are prepared to offer €51.30 per unit, accepting the 24-month term and the effective date of 1 April 2027 while maintaining our standard 30-day payment terms. While we take note of your should-cost estimate, this revised offer represents a substantial concession and reflects the reality of our production costs to ensure the quality you expect. 

Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us. For our offer, it remains a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you very much for your revised offer and for accepting the 24-month term. We truly value our long partnership with your family firm, and we appreciate that you moved on price and responded to our payment proposal.

We have compared your offer with our recent order prices for this part (po:4500001201, po:4500001288, po:4500001342).

In the same spirit, we would like to take a step towards you with two options:

- Option A: EUR 49.59 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24 months, valid from 2027-04-01
- Option B: EUR 49.43 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24 months, valid from 2026-12-01

Both give us two years of planning security together.

Is there a variant of the part or the process that would be cheaper for both of us?

We look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your revised Angebot and for the care you put into it. We appreciate that you reviewed our data, moved on price and answered our effective date option so clearly.

The long relationship between our companies matters to us, and we want it to rest on a secure footing for both sides. We have therefore moved most of the way towards your primary offer:

Option A: EUR 49.84 per unit, payment 30 days net, a 24-month term, valid from 1 December 2026.

This would give your foundry and us two years of planning security at a price very close to your own figure. Thank you also for confirming that you build strictly to our drawing. That is exactly how we value working with you.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei

move.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your kind e-mail and for taking a further step on the price. We also appreciate that you took up our proposed start date. Your family-run foundry has given us dependable quality over many years, and we value that partnership just as much as you do.

In that spirit, we have moved most of the way towards your figure so that we can settle this together soon:

Option A: EUR 49.88 per unit, payment 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 2026-12-01.

This keeps the full 24 months of security you asked for, with a price very close to your own proposal. We see it as a fair basis for continuing our cooperation for years to come.

We look forward to your reply and to working together on the next chapter.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We appreciate your continued partnership and the step you took towards our position. For many years, our family-run foundry has taken immense pride in supplying your company with components of the highest reliability.

However, a price of €49.90 per unit is the absolute limit we can offer for these terms to maintain the dependable quality you expect from our family-run foundry. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Under this offer, we provide a price of €49.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that our offer stays valid for 7 days.

We therefore present this as our final offer and look forward to concluding the agreement.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
